etymology.historical_story: Hailsham was recorded as Hamelesham in the Domesday Book of 1086. A historical survey connects the first element with a personal name and suggests that the second may refer to enclosed wet land rather than simply a settlement. The proposed interpretation suits its landscape, but remains an etymological interpretation rather than a meaning speakers assign to the modern name. [Historical survey](https://www.westsussex.gov.uk/media/1727/hailsham_eus_report_maps.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记读音 /heɪl/ + /ʃəm/，再把整词放到英国地图上：Hailsham 是地名。
